description: Source file defining a Spring Boot REST controller 'ProjectsController' that provides read-only endpoints for accessing project data stored in memory. It includes two endpoints: one for listing all projects and another for retrieving a project by ID.

classes.name: ProjectsController
classes.description: A REST controller providing read-only endpoints for project data; uses in-memory static list to store project information.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/projects, returning the list of all projects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/projects/{id}, returning a specific project matching the provided ID or 404 if not found.
